marking_points.text: ultrasound pulse generated and detected by piezoelectric quartz crystal / transducer
coupling gel used between transducer and skin to minimise reflection at skin
pulses reflected at boundaries between tissues (due to difference in acoustic impedance)
time delay between transmission and detection gives depth of boundary (s = vt/2)
intensity / amplitude of reflected pulse gives information about nature of boundary
